verdict.rationale: Replicate's public pricing page says cost estimates are published on each model's page, and that public models are billed for processing time, so per-model pricing is visible without contacting sales. The evidence shows time-based billing and 'estimates' rather than explicit per-token prices for every hosted model. Missing for 10: documented per-token price listings, confirmation that every hosted (including proprietary) model has public prices, exact rather than estimated rates, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales

citations.quote: You'll find estimates for how much any model will cost you on the model's page.
When running or training one of these public models, you only pay for the time it takes to process your request.
